raw.body:
When a Suspense boundary completion is queued into `$RB` for batched reveal, remove the `id` attribute from the content segment DOM element (`contentNodeOuter.removeAttribute('id')`). This removes the queued segment from the document's ID namespace so that subsequent inline script instructions in resumed streams (PPR) reusing the same segment ID will not match the queued segment during `document.getElementById` lookup.

---
Fixes #37078

_This PR was drafted by an AI coding agent and reviewed by a human before submission. The code was not executed or tested — please review carefully._
raw.title: Bug: 19.2 batched Suspense reveal can consume the wrong completion segment when a resumed (PPR) stream reuses a queued segment id — DOM corruption + hydration failure
